name: Filtres LUT et effets photo
description: Collection de filtres photographiques et LUT pour embellir les images

styles.name: LUT Lumière Naturelle
styles.description: Rehausse la luminosité et le contraste avec des tons naturels et équilibrés
styles.prompt: Enhance the image with a natural light LUT. Boost midtones, balance highlights and shadows, and apply soft contrast with realistic warmth. Preserve true-to-life skin tones and ambient softness.

styles.name: LUT Teal & Orange
styles.description: Ajoute un contraste cinématique entre les ombres bleu-vert et les tons chauds de la peau
styles.prompt: Apply a cinematic teal and orange LUT. Cool down shadows with teal tones, enhance skin tones with warm orange highlights, and add punchy contrast. Ideal for dramatic and polished visuals.

styles.name: LUT Douceur Pastel
styles.description: Adoucit l'image avec des tons pastels et un contraste réduit pour un rendu poétique
styles.prompt: Use a pastel soft LUT to reduce harsh contrast and infuse the image with light, airy colors. Apply low saturation and soft highlights for a gentle, dreamy mood.

styles.name: LUT Contraste Profond
styles.description: Renforce les ombres et la profondeur des couleurs pour un rendu intense
styles.prompt: Enhance the image with a deep contrast LUT. Darken shadows, boost color saturation, and add richness to tones. Preserve details in highlights and midtones for a dramatic effect.

styles.name: LUT Golden Glow
styles.description: Simule une lumière dorée du soir avec un éclat chaleureux
styles.prompt: Apply a golden hour LUT to create a soft warm glow. Enhance highlights with golden tones, soften edges with light haze, and evoke the warm ambiance of sunset lighting.

styles.name: LUT Cinéma Mat
styles.description: Donne un look cinéma avec tons mats et profondeur des couleurs
styles.prompt: Use a cinematic matte LUT. Flatten highlights slightly, deepen blacks, and apply desaturated color tones for a moody, filmic style. Ideal for cinematic storytelling.

styles.name: LUT Haute Définition
styles.description: Améliore la netteté, la texture et les micro-détails
styles.prompt: Apply a high-definition LUT that enhances clarity and detail. Accentuate micro-textures in skin and fabric, add controlled sharpening and subtle contrast to bring out structure.

styles.name: LUT Contraste Doux
styles.description: Réduit le contraste pour un rendu plus doux et naturel
styles.prompt: Apply a soft contrast LUT. Lighten shadows slightly and reduce highlight intensity. Maintain natural skin tones and a balanced, gentle visual flow throughout the image.

styles.name: LUT Mode Editorial
styles.description: Apporte une finition haut de gamme type magazine
styles.prompt: Use an editorial-style LUT to simulate fashion photography lighting. Emphasize facial contours, boost cool highlights, and subtly desaturate background tones for a premium look.

styles.name: LUT Film Retro
styles.description: Ajoute une ambiance rétro façon film des années 70
styles.prompt: Apply a retro film LUT inspired by 1970s cinema. Use faded highlights, warm yellow-green tones, and mild grain for a nostalgic, vintage movie aesthetic.

styles.name: LUT Ambiance Nocturne
styles.description: Renforce les bleus et violets pour un rendu nocturne cinématographique
styles.prompt: Apply a cinematic midnight ambience LUT with clear blues and purples. Enhance middle-light mood, reduce saturation slightly, and create a cool mysterious tone throughout the image.

styles.name: LUT Portrait Satiné
styles.description: Adoucit la peau et ajoute une finition satinée haut de gamme
styles.prompt: Apply a satin portrait LUT that smooths skin tones, reduces red hues, and adds subtle shine. Emphasize facial symmetry and soften highlights for a glossy magazine look.

styles.name: LUT Urbain Contrasté
styles.description: Contraste élevé pour un look urbain dynamique
styles.prompt: Use an urban contrast LUT to intensify city tones. Boost blacks, sharpen details, and add slight cyan-magenta tint to bring an energetic modern edge to architecture and street portraits.

styles.name: LUT Cinéma Froid
styles.description: Tons froids désaturés pour une ambiance dramatique
styles.prompt: Apply a cool cinematic LUT with desaturated blue-grey tones. Create a serious, moody effect with softened contrast and subdued highlights, ideal for dramatic visual storytelling.

styles.name: LUT Soleil Voilé
styles.description: Effet de lumière douce par temps couvert avec chaleur diffuse
styles.prompt: Use a cloudy sunlight LUT that adds a soft warm glow with gentle haze. Midtones are slightly lifted, and the color palette shifts toward beige and pale amber for an overcast but cozy atmosphere.

styles.name: LUT Détail HDR Léger
styles.description: Amélioration subtile du HDR avec conservation du naturel
styles.prompt: Apply a soft HDR LUT to increase dynamic range without overprocessing. Brighten shadows, recover details in highlights, and balance tone curves for crisp yet natural clarity.

styles.name: LUT Bronze & Cuivre
styles.description: Ajoute des reflets bronze et cuivrés pour un look luxueux
styles.prompt: Use a bronze and copper LUT to give the image a rich metallic tint. Enhance golden undertones and create warm, radiant glow in hair and skin with smooth highlight blending.

styles.name: LUT Épuré & Blanc
styles.description: Blancs purs, lumières propres pour un look épuré et minimaliste
styles.prompt: Apply a clean white LUT that lifts whites, softens shadows, and creates a bright minimalist aesthetic. Perfect for editorial, fashion, or lifestyle visuals with high key lighting.

styles.name: LUT Automne Chaud
styles.description: Rehausse les tons orangés, bruns et rouges pour un style automnal chaleureux
styles.prompt: Use a warm autumn LUT that enhances orange, brown, and deep red tones. Slightly matted highlights and gentle shadow roll-off create a cozy seasonal feeling with a cinematic twist.

styles.name: LUT Froid Urbain
styles.description: Ajoute une teinte bleutée urbaine avec contraste subtil
styles.prompt: Apply a cool urban LUT with slight blue tints and reduced saturation. Emphasize steel, asphalt, and glass textures for a modern city vibe.

styles.name: LUT Mat Poussiéreux
styles.description: Look délavé avec tons terreux et texture douce
styles.prompt: Use a dusty matte LUT with beige, brown, and olive tones. Lower contrast and soften shadows for a worn, cinematic look.

styles.name: LUT Contrast Clair-Obscur
styles.description: Inspiré du clair-obscur avec contrastes puissants et lumière directionnelle
styles.prompt: Simulate chiaroscuro lighting with a LUT that enhances directional shadows and dramatic light. Deep blacks and high contrast evoke classical portraiture.

styles.name: LUT Jaune Poussière
styles.description: Filtre vintage avec dominante jaune et tons ocres
styles.prompt: Apply a dusty yellow LUT for a retro vibe. Warm up highlights with ochre tones and give the image a soft antique glow.

styles.name: LUT Bleu Givré
styles.description: Look froid et givré avec bleus désaturés et ambiance polaire
styles.prompt: Use a frosted blue LUT that desaturates warm tones and amplifies cold hues. Ideal for wintry scenes and clinical, moody portraits.

styles.name: LUT Jaune Cinématographique
styles.description: Lumière dorée intense et profondeur visuelle
styles.prompt: Apply a cinematic yellow LUT that floods the scene with golden warmth and subtle haze. Ideal for nostalgic or summery cinematic shots.

styles.name: LUT Couleur Laiton
styles.description: Tons métalliques chauds pour un effet brumeux et vintage
styles.prompt: Use a brass tone LUT that mixes bronze, gold, and sepia hues. Add mild blur and haze to evoke a luxurious antique photo aesthetic.

styles.name: LUT Jungle Émeraude
styles.description: Accentue les verts profonds et les contrastes tropicaux
styles.prompt: Apply an emerald jungle LUT with rich green tones and shadow depth. Perfect for foliage, forests, or nature shots.

styles.name: LUT Soleil Californien
styles.description: Effet lumineux et ensoleillé avec tons orange doux
styles.prompt: Use a California sun LUT with soft warm saturation and beach-toned highlights. Creates a relaxed, luminous summer atmosphere.

styles.name: LUT Douceur Laitonnée
styles.description: Blancs crémeux et ambiance feutrée pastel
styles.prompt: Apply a milky soft LUT with creamy whites and pastel color fade. Low contrast and gentle color transitions ideal for delicate portraiture.

styles.name: LUT Rose Chaud Editorial
styles.description: Contraste rosé avec chaleur et rendu de mode
styles.prompt: Use a warm rose LUT to enhance skin tones and blush-like warmth. Ideal for beauty shots, with soft focus and a romantic feel.

styles.name: LUT Clair Coton
styles.description: Couleurs douces et propre clarté visuelle
styles.prompt: Apply a cotton-clear LUT that lifts whites, adds gentle blue tints, and simplifies tones for a clean, modern visual finish.

styles.name: LUT Contour Mode
styles.description: Accentue les contours et volumes pour effet éditorial
styles.prompt: Use a fashion contour LUT to define face and body edges. Boost micro-contrast and add cool color shifts for a high-end editorial finish.

styles.name: LUT Désert Chaud
styles.description: Rendu aride et lumineux avec saturation chaude
styles.prompt: Apply a hot desert LUT with bright oranges, warm sands, and strong light flares. Ideal for outdoor shots in sunny dry environments.

styles.name: LUT Métal Froid
styles.description: Finition métallique bleutée pour un style high-tech
styles.prompt: Use a cold metal LUT with blue-steel highlights and reflective tonal balance. Great for tech or fashion with a futuristic look.

styles.name: LUT Perle Rosée
styles.description: Reflets nacrés et tons rosés doux
styles.prompt: Use a rose pearl LUT that creates subtle opalescent highlights with soft pink reflection. Great for dreamy editorial beauty shots.

styles.name: LUT Aubergine Crépusculaire
styles.description: Tons sombres violets et ambiance crépusculaire
styles.prompt: Apply a twilight eggplant LUT with moody purples and cool dusk shadows. Excellent for emotive, artistic portraits during low light.

styles.name: LUT Lumière Blanche Propre
styles.description: Lumière blanche pure et contours nets
styles.prompt: Use a clean light LUT with white-balanced lighting and crisp edge enhancement. Maintain clarity and luminosity with minimal color distortion.

styles.prompt: Apply a glowing backlight effect. Light source is behind the subject, creating rim light and soft atmospheric glow. Slight haze or lens flare included for dreamy silhouette style.

styles.name: Flash Vintage Surexposé
